title: Dutch central bank moves 86 tons of gold from US and Canada to London
excerpt:
The Dutch central bank has transferred approximately 86 metric tons of gold from the U.S. and Canada to the U.K., seeking to shore up its contingency planning amid “increasing geopolitical unrest.”

Just over one quarter of the central bank’s gold reserves held in New York and Ottawa was shifted to London between March and August, the bank said.

This will be one of the Great Pieces of American Architecture, honoring the history and significance of Arlington Cemetery and befitting the most powerful Capital in the World.

author: @foxnewspolitics
title: White House launches MAGA remakes of Snake, Flappy Bird, and Tetris
excerpt:
FIRST ON FOX: The White House is launching a website featuring Trump-themed remakes of classic video games — including a version of Snake where Border Czar Tom Homan leads a line of illegal aliens in orange jumpsuits, a Flappy Bird clone with a bald eagle soaring over the National Mall and a Tetris-style game where the goal is to build a border wall.

There's also a boxing game where players punch away unhealthy foods in a nod to RFK Jr.'s Make America Healthy Again push, complete with a "Seed Oils" graphic crossed out in red. Another game has users catching gold bars and money in front of the Washington Monument.

"This is an effort to further contrast between a culture of fun and winning and the dark socialist vision Democrats have for America," a White House official told Fox News Digital.
